Name:
Childish Gambino - Cruisin' [V3]
(feat. Yeat)
(Cruisin' Thru Africa)
Notes\n(Join the Discord if we missed an: On January 7, 2024, Yeat posted an Instagram Story captioned "me n gambino going chips for grass and yall would never know," first teasing a Childish Gambino collaboration. On January 31, Yeat announced that his album 2093 was going to drop in February in an Instagram slideshow captioned "2093ISCOMING...... 2.??.42," including an image of him in the studio with Childish Gambino, once again suggesting teasing an appearance on what ended up being on "Power Trip." On February 24, 2024, Yeat posted the credits of "Power Trip" with Donald Glover's name in an Instagram Story captioned "Dont worry we have more for yall," indicating at least another collaboration between the two. It is likely that Yeat recorded his vocals for the track during the same session as "Power Trip."
